rows.question: Same number as the badge row

goal.md sets size S but also says done = QA whitebox PASS. S has no QA whitebox, allows 1–2 tasks, and no risk flag; this scope has about 10 tasks and a security flag (localhost bind, token-guarded jump). Which size?
rows.options: A) S + QA whitebox: Tech Lead plans, QA whitebox signs off, Developer evidence replaces QA blackbox. Logged as a process exception. B) Full M: add a BA and a QA blackbox (testing via replay mode). C) S exactly as in process.md: Tech Lead review only.
rows.manager's recommendation: A. The spec is complete, so a BA adds little. QA whitebox matches goal.md's done rule and covers the security flag. Revisit QA blackbox in iteration 2 when the page exists.

rows.question: BRD-02..06 must branch from code that has BRD-01, and only the PO merges. When BRD-01 passes QA whitebox, will you merge squad/dev-board-1 into squad-board-spec? Please also commit the tickets, design.md and the --effort change first, so new worktrees have them.
rows.options: A) PO merges BRD-01 as soon as it passes, and the Manager pings you. B) Developers stack on squad/dev-board-1, branching from it by hand; this needs a base-ref option in squad-spawn, which is outside the goal.
rows.answer: 2026-10-12: PO delegated decisions to the Manager. Manager chose stacking: the Manager creates each worktree from the passed BRD-01 commit before squad-spawn, which reuses it. A final integration ticket combines the passed branches on one Developer branch. The PO merges once at the end.

rows.question: The Developer permission settings deny git merge, so dev-board-8 can't merge the passed branches into its own BRD-09 branch. The Manager's stacked-branches plan missed this; neither the Manager nor an agent may work around it.
rows.options: A) Allow merge for this run: remove Bash(git merge:*) from the project copy squad/settings/dev.json only (the plugin template stays). git push, rebase, reset --hard and checkout main stay denied. B) The PO runs the merges into squad/dev-board-8 by hand (5 now, 1 more for BRD-06, ~7 in iteration 2). C) The PO merges each passed branch into squad-board-spec as it passes, as in the original process.
rows.manager's recommendation: A. It's one change, and it ends the blocks for both integrations. The process already limits merges to a Developer's own branch.
rows.blocks: BRD-09, then BRD-08 and all of iteration 2
rows.answer: 2026-10-12: A (PO). Done: merge allowed in squad/settings/dev.json.
